title: 第5章 配方第6章 猩红菌尸
content_zh:
凯撒在村外的雪坡上，思索着有什么可行的办法可以顺利进入到村内。
突然！
一股悸动毫无征兆地从他体内传来！
凯撒心中猛地一惊，但很快便知道这是那本书，它竟然自己出来了！
这一次和以往完全不同！
过去，这本书外表厚重，一旦翻开内里所有的书页都会瞬间消失。
但这一次凯撒翻开后，原本应是空白的地方，一张散发着红光的书页凭空浮现！
那红色像是血液在燃烧，页面上布满了扭曲古老的符号和文字，它们不属于凯撒前世所知的任何文明，也不同于他穿越后在这个世界的语言。
然而，当凯撒的目光聚焦在那些扭曲的符文上时，它们的含义竟直接烙印进了他的意识深处，无需理解，仿佛本能般知晓。
【泥土填塞于猩红菌尸之口，刻画符文，可得猩红之种】
【吞服！
根茎将于宿主臂内萌发，化生利刃，汲取生命】
【持续时间由宿主强度而定】
两段信息直接传入凯撒的脑海，随后的是一幅简约却无比清晰的图画。
画面中央是一个蜷缩的人体轮廓，其周身覆盖着密密麻麻的红色绒毛。
以人体为中心，一个由复杂符文构成的圆圈将其牢牢圈住，人体的头部被特意放大，嘴巴大张着，里面填满泥土。
随后一股更加强烈的冲击感席卷而来，他的意识瞬间穿越了村口游荡的怪物，直接投射到了村子内部的某个角落。
视角急速下坠，是村子的中心地带，一栋还算完好的木屋前，地上赫然躺着一具尸体！
那不是普通的尸体，尸体表面覆盖着一层厚厚缓慢蠕动着的猩红色绒毛，那些绒毛散发着微弱却清晰的血色荧光。
这形象让凯撒想起了前世影视中的“毛僵”

，只不过眼前的，是更加诡异的猩红版本！
“猩红菌尸……”
凯撒在心中默念着刚刚获得的信息，瞬间明悟。
下一秒，那股拉扯他意识的力量骤然消失，他的视野猛地被拉回现实，重新聚焦在手中散发着红芒的书页上。
“原来……是这样！”
凯撒大概搞明白了这本书的使用方法，他似乎是需要接触到某些特定的物质，或者是在某一个范围内的特定物质，就会显现出一种特殊的配方。
书中提示的方法和那具尸体的画面，给凯撒提供了一条新的道路。
那“猩红种子”
所化的“植物剑”
，无疑是他眼下最渴求的活下去的力量！
凯撒的眼神变得无比灼热，他小心翼翼地将血肉之书合拢，重新沉入他腹部的皮肤之下。
凯撒目光再次投向那座被死亡阴影笼罩的村庄。
“看来……这次是真的要拿命去拼一波了。”
凯撒舔了舔干裂起皮的嘴唇，机遇与死亡，就在那具发光的尸体上，“必须得到它！”
凯撒没有立刻行动，莽撞只会送死，他需要准备，书上提到的泥土也要提前准备好。
content_en:
Caesar was on the snowy slope outside the village, thinking about any feasible way to enter the village smoothly.
Sudden!
A throbbing came from his body without any warning!
Caesar was shocked, but he soon knew that this was the book, and it came out on its own!
This time is completely different from before!
In the past, this book had a heavy appearance, and all the pages inside would disappear instantly once opened.
But this time when Caesar opened it, a page glowing with red light appeared out of thin air where it should have been blank!
The red color was like blood burning, and the page was covered with twisted ancient symbols and words. They did not belong to any civilization that Caesar knew in his previous life, and they were also different from the language of this world after he traveled through time.
However, when Caesar's eyes focused on those twisted runes, their meanings were directly imprinted into the depths of his consciousness, without any need to understand, as if he knew them instinctively.
[Stuff soil into the mouth of the scarlet fungus corpse and carve runes to get the scarlet seed]
【Swallow!
The rhizome will sprout from the host's arm, transform into a sharp blade, and absorb life]
[The duration depends on the strength of the host]
Two pieces of information went directly into Caesar's mind, followed by a simple but extremely clear picture.
In the center of the painting is the outline of a curled-up human body, covered with dense red down.
With the human body as the center, a circle composed of complex runes tightly surrounds it. The head of the human body is deliberately enlarged, the mouth is wide open, and the inside is filled with soil.
Then a stronger sense of impact swept over him, and his consciousness instantly passed through the monsters wandering at the entrance of the village and was directly projected to a corner inside the village.
The angle of view dropped rapidly, and it was in the center of the village. In front of a relatively intact wooden house, there was a corpse lying on the ground!
That was no ordinary corpse. The surface of the corpse was covered with a thick layer of slowly crawling scarlet fuzz, which emitted a weak but clear blood-colored fluorescence.
This image reminds Caesar of "Mao Zong" in movies and TV shows in his previous life.
, but what’s in front of you is an even weirder scarlet version!
"Scarlet corpse..."
Caesar silently recited the information he had just obtained in his mind, and realized it instantly.
The next second, the force pulling on his consciousness suddenly disappeared, and his vision was suddenly pulled back to reality, and he refocused on the red glowing book page in his hand.
"So...that's it!"
Caesar probably figured out how to use this book. It seemed that he needed to come into contact with certain specific substances, or specific substances within a certain range, and a special formula would appear.
The method suggested in the book and the picture of the corpse provided Caesar with a new path.
The "Scarlet Seed"
The transformed “Plant Sword”
, is undoubtedly the power to survive that he desires most right now!
Caesar's eyes became extremely hot, and he carefully closed the Book of Flesh and sank under the skin of his abdomen again.
Caesar looked again at the village shrouded in the shadow of death.
"It seems... I really have to risk my life this time."
Caesar licked his chapped lips, opportunity and death, on that glowing corpse, "Must have it!"
Caesar did not act immediately. Being reckless would only lead to death. He needed to prepare, and the soil mentioned in the book must also be prepared in advance.
